items.t: Intake plenum gasket leak (Magnum V8/V6)
items.job: Repair intake plenum with updated plate or gasket kit
items.note: Add new spark plugs if they are oil-fouled. Cost rises if the catalytic converter is already clogged.

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing (46RE/47RE)
items.job: Replace transmission with a remanufactured 46RE/47RE unit
items.note: Reman prices assume you return the old unit as a core. A used transmission costs less.

items.t: Camshaft position sensor failure (Magnum)
items.job: Replace camshaft position sensor (in the distributor)

items.t: Ticking from broken exhaust manifold bolts
items.job: Extract broken manifold bolts and replace gasket
items.note: Price is per side. Cost rises if the manifold is cracked or warped and must be replaced.

items.t: Worn front ball joints and tie rods
items.job: Replace front upper and lower ball joints and tie rod ends
items.note: Covers both sides. Add a wheel alignment afterward.

items.t: Blend door problems cause weak or one-temperature airflow
items.job: Replace HVAC blend door actuator
items.note: If the blend door itself is broken, the dash may have to come out, which costs much more.

items.t: Overheating and head gasket failure (4.7L)
items.job: Replace both head gaskets and have the heads checked
items.note: Includes head bolts and resurfacing. Cost rises a lot if a head is cracked or the valve seats dropped.

items.t: Hemi lifter and camshaft wear (Hemi tick)
items.job: Replace camshaft and lifters
items.note: Dealer parts sit at the high end. Cost rises a lot if metal debris damaged the rest of the engine.

items.t: Truck can roll out of Park (recall)
items.job: Update software and replace shift interlock if needed
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ram dealer.

items.t: Power-locking tailgate can open while driving (recall)
items.job: Repair tailgate latch per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ram dealer.

items.t: EcoDiesel EGR cooler can crack (recall)
items.job: Replace EGR cooler and inspect intake manifold
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN. Cost rises if the intake manifold also needs replacing.

items.t: EcoDiesel high-pressure fuel pump failure (recalls)
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump
items.note: Free under the recall for covered VINs. If debris spread, injectors, rails and lines are replaced too, costing far more.

items.t: EcoDiesel crankshaft tone wheel can come apart (recall)
items.job: Engine computer software update per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ram dealer.

items.t: Side curtain airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.job: Replace side curtain airbags per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN and book as soon as parts are available.

items.t: Loss of power steering assist (recalls)
items.job: Secure battery ground fastener; replace steering gear if needed
items.note: Free under the recalls. One also covers a steering gear fault on a small number of trucks. Check your VIN.

items.t: Tailgate strikers out of alignment (recall)
items.job: Adjust or replace tailgate strikers per recall
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Ram dealer.

items.t: Second row seat belt anchors may not be properly attached
items.job: Inspect and reattach second row seat belt anchors
items.note: Free under recall 26V-495. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Stability control can switch off from an ABS software fault
items.job: Update anti-lock brake module software
items.note: Free under recall 24V-653. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Turn signal may not cancel on its own
items.job: Replace steering column control module
items.note: Free under recall 24V-729. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering column module weld can stop the driver airbag working
items.job: Inspect and replace steering column module
items.note: Free under recall 24V-199. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Transmission control unit can leak fluid and cut drive
items.job: Replace transmission valve body and control unit
items.note: Free under recall 24V-413. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Instrument cluster can go blank from a software fault
items.job: Update software or replace instrument cluster
items.note: Free under recalls 25V-826 and 26V-225. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Damaged wheel hub sensor ring can disable stability control
items.job: Replace front wheel hub and bearing assembly
items.note: Free under recall 24V-794. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Headlight wiring can make the parking and daytime lights flicker
items.job: Replace headlight assemblies
items.note: Free under recall 26V-421. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Missing clip at the brake master cylinder (do-not-drive recall)
items.job: Install brake master cylinder push rod clip
items.note: Do not drive. Free under recall 21V-037, including the tow in most cases. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Heated tow mirror glass can come off
items.job: Replace heated tow mirror glass
items.note: Free under recall 24V-754. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering control module fault can affect driver airbag deployment
items.job: Replace steering control module
items.note: Free under recall 25V-765. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Tire pressure sensors may miss low pressure
items.job: Replace tire pressure sensors
items.note: Free under recall 26V-623. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Power module (TIPM) faults cause no-start and stalling
items.job: Replace totally integrated power module and program it to the truck
items.note: A rebuilt or relay-repaired module costs less than a new one but needs programming either way.
